_comment: A01 installer staging contract: reviewed, itemized inventory of what a real StockMonitor distribution must stage. Each entry is checked by scripts/tooling/audit_packaging.cjs. status meanings: required_present = staged and verified present today; required_missing = a real gap, still correctly fails the build closed; external_prerequisite = intentionally NOT bundled (documented product decision, verified reachable at runtime instead, not at build time).

categories.label: Runtime contract (protocol/version identity all processes must agree on)
Python launcher entry points (backend gateway + market/futu daemons)
Locked Python dependency set (Windows x64 / CPython 3.14, generated by scripts/tooling/lock_dependencies.py)
Full installed-package metadata evidence (requires_dist per package, for a redistributable environment audit)
Rust Market Runtime executable (cargo build --release output)
Rust Analysis Runtime (B) executable (cargo build --release in native/analysis_runtime; packaged as native/analysis_runtime.exe)

Microsoft Visual C++ runtime DLLs for the Rust executables and the bundled onnxruntime (scripts/tooling/stage_vc_runtime.py, from the Visual Studio Redist folder; packaged into native/ and app-runtime/python/)
Toolchain evidence (node/electron/rustc/cargo) matching the current pins: package.json electron and engines.node, both crates' rust-toolchain.toml
categories.note: existence alone is not enough -- audit_packaging.cjs compares every recorded tool version with its pin

categories.label: A redistributable Python interpreter staged for packaged mode (no host PATH python)
categories.note: 2026-10-06 (W7): scripts/tooling/stage_python_runtime.py vendors the python.org embeddable CPython and a pip wheel, both pinned with sha256 in requirements/python-bootstrap.json (R11-03), and installs requirements/core.lock + models.lock from PyPI wheels with --require-hashes. The broker SDKs (shioaji, moomoo-api) are NOT staged (Q52): this check fails if they are present, and the per-provider install lists (packaging/python/provider_sdk/*.txt) must exist. pip stays in the runtime because the user installs the SDKs with it (packaging/install_provider_sdk.ps1). Executables outside an allowlist fail the staging step (R11-16). launch_runtime.js's getProjectRoot() resolves the packaged app-runtime/ root; resolveLaunchVarRoot() places VAR_ROOT under Electron's userData.

categories.label: Broker SDKs (shioaji, moomoo-api): installed by the user, not shipped
categories.note: Q52 (2026-10-05): until their redistribution terms are confirmed the installer contains neither SDK. install_provider_sdk.ps1 installs the locked versions (hash-checked, --no-deps) with the bundled pip into %APPDATA%\StockMonitor\provider-sdk; the staged sitecustomize.py adds that directory to sys.path. Without them the providers report the missing SDK and the rest of the app runs.

categories.label: Futu/Moomoo OpenD gateway process
categories.note: by explicit security design StockMonitor never handles the user's Futu login -- the user installs and logs into the official OpenD program separately. This is a runtime reachability check (backend probes OpenD's local port), not a build-time staging item, and must not be bundled.

categories.label: electron-builder files/extraResources manifest separating readonly app resources from a writable runtime/data root
categories.note: package.json now declares the readonly app-runtime resources and the expected packaging/python runtime location. The separate redistributable_python_interpreter category remains fail-closed until that real runtime is staged and verified.
